title: Site Service Technician
description:
**Orion Group Life Sciences are currently recruiting a Site Service Technician on behalf of our Multinational Biopharmaceutical Client based in Tuas, Singapore on an initial 12-month contract with potential to extend.**
**Position Summary**
The Site Services Technician provides on-site hands-on IT support to the employees, contractors, and business partners. This role is responsible for delivering high-quality deskside support, managing end-user devices and assets, supporting onboarding and offboarding activities, assisting with meeting room and executive support, and serving as smart hands for infrastructure and other BTS teams when physical intervention is required.
  
As an insourced team member, the Site Services Technician operates within client’s Site Services organization and follows standardized ITSM, compliance, asset, and change management processes to ensure consistent, secure, and reliable support. 
  
\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
**End-User Device Support**
• Troubleshoot and resolve issues with Windows laptops and desktops, monitors, docking stations, mobile devices, printers, scanners, headsets, and other standard peripherals.
  
• Provide best-effort support for Mac devices, where applicable.
  
• Perform hardware repairs, replacements, or coordinate warranty/service vendor support as needed.
  
• Reimage, upgrade, configure, retire, and dispose of devices in accordance with company procedures and e-waste requirements.
  
  
**Asset and Inventory Management**
• Maintain local inventory of end-user devices, loaners, spare equipment, and consumables.
  
• Update asset records in ServiceNow or other approved asset systems.
  
• Conduct inventory audits and reconcile discrepancies.
  
• Manage device lifecycle activities including deployment, swap, return, and retirement.
  
  
**Onboarding and Offboarding**
• Support first-day setup for new employees and contractors, including hardware, accounts, and access readiness.
  
• Coordinate retrieval of equipment and ensure proper deprovisioning during employee or contractor exits.
  
• Follow offboarding checklists to ensure compliance, asset recovery, and timely closure of access requests.
  
  
**Meeting, Event, and Executive Support**
• Provide technical support for conference rooms, town halls, VIP visits, and site events.
  
• Assist with meeting room AV, collaboration tools, Teams/Zoom setup, and related troubleshooting.
  
• Escalate advanced AV or telepresence issues to the appropriate support team or vendor.
  
  
**Smart Hands for Infrastructure Teams**
• Act as the onsite physical support resource for Network, Server, Telecom, and other BTS teams.
  
• Perform approved tasks such as power cycling equipment, swapping components, verifying indicators, or escorting vendors.
  
• Follow instructions from expert teams and escalate issues beyond onsite scope.
  
  
**Local IT Administration**
• Maintain local runbooks, site knowledge articles, contact lists, and support documentation.
  
• Help keep IT spaces secure, organized, and compliant with local policy.
  
• Support local IT projects such as office moves, conference room setup, hardware refreshes, or site expansions.
  
  
**Ticket and Service Management**
• Manage incidents, service requests, tasks, and changes in ServiceNow.
  
• Maintain accurate notes, updates, resolution details, and time entries.
  
• Monitor queue health, respond to alerts, and ensure tickets are acted on within expected timeframes.
  
• Follow IT change management and approval processes for work requiring formal change control.
  
  
**Collaboration and Escalation**
• Work closely with the Service Desk, other BTS support teams, regional leaders, and approved vendors.
  
• Escalate issues appropriately when problems fall outside scope, access, or expertise.
  
• Provide clear updates to users and stakeholders throughout issue resolution.
  
• Partner with the Site Service Leader or regional manager on operational priorities, escalations, and process gaps.
  
  
**Compliance, Safety, and Security**
• Complete all required onboarding, security, and site-specific training before working independently.
  
• Follow security, confidentiality, and data protection requirements.
  
• Adhere to EHS, GMP, GxP, and site-specific procedures when supporting regulated environments.
  
• Maintain audit-ready documentation and comply with all local and enterprise policies.
  
  
**Additional Responsibilities (Level II)**
• Handle more complex and escalated incidents independently, including recurring and multi-user issues, and drive them to resolution.
  
• Act as a point of contact for Site Service Technician I and provide day-to-day guidance and knowledge sharing.
  
• Lead or coordinate local projects such as office moves, hardware refreshes, and conference room setups.
  
• Contribute to improving runbooks, knowledge articles, and site support processes.
  
  
**Success Factors**
• Deliver timely, high-quality onsite support.
  
• Maintain accurate documentation and asset records.
  
• Protect compliance, safety, and security at all times.
  
• Communicate clearly and proactively with users and support teams.
  
• Take ownership of issues from start to finish.
  
• Contribute to a strong, insourced service culture focused on accountability and continuous improvement.
  
  
**Required Qualifications**
• 3+ years’ Experience providing deskside or end-user IT support in a corporate environment.
  
• Strong troubleshooting skills for Windows devices, peripherals, and standard workplace technologies.
  
• Familiarity with ITSM tools such as ServiceNow.
  
• Experience with asset tracking, device deployment, and lifecycle support.
  
• Ability to communicate effectively with users, peers, leadership, and vendors.
  
• Strong customer service mindset and professionalism.
  
• Ability to follow procedures, maintain documentation, and work within compliance requirements.
  
  
**People**
are our business
**worldwide**
Orion Group was founded in 1987 and is now one of the largest, independent, international recruitment companies. We have a network of 200 employees working from 24 offices, delivering a range of services – Talent Acquisition, Recruitment Outsourcing Services, Retained Search, Global Workforce Solutions, Completions & Commissioning and Materials Management – across 68 countries. As a global leader in workforce solutions, we recruit personnel across the Engineering & Technical, Office & Commercial, Scientific and Skilled Trades disciplines, for sectors including Oil & Gas, Life Science, Power & Utilities, Constructions & Infrastructure, Manufacturing and Renewables.

title: Assistant Vice President, Specialist, Architect, Technology and Operations
description:
**Job Summary:**

* Experienced Security Architect role focused on strengthening the Bank’s and vendors’ security architecture, regulatory compliance, and ATM logical security.
* Responsible for assessing and improving security posture across systems, data, applications, and networks in line with industry standards, regulations, and best practices.

**Key Responsibilities:**
**Security Architecture Design:**

* Design and implement robust security architecture for cloud, on-premises, and hybrid environments.
* Conduct internal architecture reviews to validate design adequacy, security controls, and alignment with Bank standards before implementation, followed by annual or half-yearly reviews based on criticality.
* Develop and enforce security policies, standards, and procedures across systems and applications.
* Define security requirements, understand data flows, and partner with teams to enable secure design and integration.

**Risk Management & Compliance:**

* Conduct risk assessments and recommend mitigation strategies.
* Ensure compliance with relevant regulatory frameworks, including ISO 27001, NIST, and PCI-DSS.
* Support audits and regulatory responses across DPSC, RBI Cybersecurity Framework, SEBI CSCRF, IT outsourcing, and digital lending requirements.

**ATM Logical Security:**

* Ensure ATM logical controls are aligned with Bank standards.
* Conduct periodic ATM security assessments covering vulnerabilities, host security, and control effectiveness.
* Perform governance reviews of ATM logical security controls.

**Collaboration & Guidance:**

* Act as a security advisor to business, IT, vendors, partners, and application teams.
* Lead threat modeling and security reviews for new systems, projects, and services.

**Regulatory Reporting:**

* Ensure timely and accurate submission of regulatory returns and reports, including Quarterly Cyber KRI and Tranche I, II, and III submissions.
* Maintain records of regulatory submissions, approvals, and RBI correspondence.

**Training & Awareness:**

* Conduct training and awareness on RBI regulations and compliance practices.
* Promote regulatory compliance and ethical conduct across the organization.

**Monitoring & Response:**

* Partner with Security Operations to enhance monitoring and incident response capabilities.
* Support security breach investigations and root cause analysis.

**Security Tools & Technologies:**

* Manage security solutions such as SIEM, EDR, WAF, and IAM.
* Track emerging cybersecurity trends, technologies, and threat landscapes.

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or a related field; Master’s preferred.
* 10+ years of cybersecurity experience, including 5+ years in security architecture or engineering.
* Preferred certifications: CISSP, CISM, CISA, AWS/Azure/GCP Security Specialty, or equivalent.

**Skills & Competencies:**

* Strong understanding of security principles, architecture, and technologies.
* Strong knowledge of cloud platforms, including AWS, Azure, and GCP, and cloud security frameworks.
* Familiarity with microservices and container security, including Docker and Kubernetes.
* Proven ability to conduct security assessments and interpret security reports.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to engage internal and external stakeholders effectively.
  
  
**Location:**
I-Think Techno, Kanjurmarg
  
  
**Job:**
Technology
  
  
**Schedule:**
Regular
  
  
**Employee Status:**
Full time
